summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 5,000,000 ordinary shares on 30 June 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 111.3093 pence per share, as part of its existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares were bought from Goldman Sachs International and will be cancelled. This is a routine open-market repurchase under a previously announced programme, not a significant special situation event. The filing is a foreign private issuer disclosure under Rule 13a-16. There are no structural changes, advisory roles, or risk-arb elements; it reflects ordinary capital return execution.
